title: BenchBench-Protocol: Evaluating Real-World Wet-Lab Protocol Reasoning and Modification
abstract: arXiv:2608.23898v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce BenchBench-Protocol, a benchmark for large language models of 149 protocol-modification tasks recovered from modifications that scientists made to published protocols during real experimental work. Adapting a published protocol to a new experiment is a routine task for a wet-lab scientist, and a correct modification requires accounting for prior choices and downstream steps. Recent life-science benchmarks have moved toward open-ended, rubric-graded tasks, but tasks are typically elicited from experts rather than reconstructed from real-world modifications. BenchBench-Protocol tasks are derived from differences between a published protocol and a version a scientist modified, which provides the basis for the query and the weighted rubric elements for a correct response. translated_title: BenchBench-Protocol：评估现实世界湿实验方案推理与修改
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23898v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们介绍了BenchBench-Protocol，一个用于大型语言模型的基准测试，包含149个协议修改任务，这些任务来源于科学家在实际实验工作中对已发表协议进行的修改。将已发表的协议适应于新实验是湿实验室科学家的常规任务，正确的修改需要考虑到先前的选择和后续步骤。最近的生命科学基准测试已转向开放式、基于评分标准的任务，但任务通常由专家引出，而非从现实世界的修改中重构。BenchBench-Protocol任务源于已发表协议与科学家修改版本之间的差异，这为查询和正确响应的加权评分标准提供了基础。该基准测试涵盖九个湿实验生物学领域的96个源协议，并且仅包含经领域专家审查后被评为高分的任务。我们进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于现实湿实验方案修改的基准测试BenchBench-Protocol，用于评估大语言模型在协议推理和修改方面的能力，其任务来源于科学家的实际修改记录，并由专家评审确保质量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BenchBench-Protocol, a benchmark derived from real-world wet-lab protocol modifications, to evaluate large language models' reasoning and modification capabilities, with tasks sourced from actual scientist edits and expert-reviewed for quality.
